segments.title: Holiday Cold Open & Hype Train Santa Parade
segments.notes: Case opens with holiday greetings, haircut reveal, and an extended Hype Train bit cycling through AI-generated Santa personas (Spud Kringle, Tim Crangle, Chris Hypedal) while thanking subs and bits.

segments.title: Jeff Ripple Reports: AI Porn Doppelgangers
segments.notes: Ripple reads a Washington Post piece on adult creators licensing AI chatbot doubles (Sophie AI); Case and Jeff test the site live, joke about Kevin sex bots, and Ripple threatens a three-month holiday break before settling on Tuesday return.

segments.title: Joe Rogan Experience: Twizzler Suspenders & Golden Camels
segments.notes: Case and Jamie riff as dual Joe Rogans: Jamie's edible Twizzler suspenders fail, Joe defends Musk labor practices, demands real Christmas trees hunted with AK-47s, pitches beehive-mailbox economy, and debates non-denominational gay Santa day.

segments.title: Conspiracy Time: The Unverted Exposes Christmas as Saturnalia Psyop
segments.notes: The Unverted (Case) speeds through a YouTube video claiming Christmas is a pagan Saturnalia fraud, Jesus born in September, and Russell Crowe is a time-traveling demon seeding truth via Gladiator; Case gets rattled but pivots to trailers.

segments.title: Let's Go to the Movies: Trent Reviews Spaceman, Land of Bad, The Regime
segments.notes: Trent (Case) watches trailers from a rented theater: Adam Sandler in Spaceman (disappointed by river scenes), Russell Crowe seated in Land of Bad (dream Professor X casting), and Kate Winslet in The Regime (Margaret Thatcher energy, Bubble Boy cameo).

segments.title: Munch & Crum: Scrum vs. Crum Debate & Poll
segments.notes: Crum returns after 'burying the hatchet' on the grunge stream; Munch introduces Scrum (one-day temp) as superior, chat poll runs close, Crum claims opaque emotional black box, Munch threatens destruction, scoreboard updated to 83.

segments.title: DJ Music: Munch's Christmas Freestyle & Sign-Off
segments.notes: Munch rushes through a Rudolph-replacing 'Munch Miss' rap claiming immortality, nuclear curse power, and real Santa status; DJ Newsic rates the stream, Case scrambles to end before Patreon creamies stream.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors holiday broadcast, cycles Santa personas for Hype Train, hosts Jo Rogen and Unverted bits, manages segment sprint to Patreon stream.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Walks through frame, approves Case's haircut, cues signature theme music.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: correspondent. Delivers AI porn doppelganger story, threatens extended holiday leave, negotiates return to Tuesday.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: hype train. Derails into AI Santa parade (Spud Kringle, Tim Crangle, Chris Hypedal) while acknowledging subs and bits.

characters.name: The Unverted
characters.notes: conspiracy host. Speed-runs Christmas-as-Saturnalia conspiracy video, implicates Russell Crowe as time-traveling demon.

characters.name: Trent
characters.notes: field correspondent. Reviews movie trailers from rented theater: Spaceman, Land of Bad, The Regime; claims six-month school break.

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Champions Scrum over Crum, claims nuclear curse immortality, delivers 'Munch Miss' Christmas rap as real Santa.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: debate analyst. Returns after grunge-stream reconciliation, defends opaque emotional black box, loses chat poll to Scrum narrowly.

characters.name: DJ Newsic
characters.notes: musical finale host. Rates Munch's freestyle, closes broadcast with holiday sign-off before Patreon pivot.

storylines.beat: Crum back on-air after 'burying the hatchet' on grunge stream; Munch revives rivalry by introducing Scrum as replacement, chat poll runs 50/50, scoreboard updated to 83.
Scrum (one-day temp hire) becomes flashpoint; Case reveals year-long Scrum contract; Munch claims Crum's hands destroy mugs, Crum claims emotional radiation-proof black box.

Claims to be nuclearly powered by a curse, immortal, and the real Santa who rides Rudolph [1:34:35].
Rented movie theater on three-year contract for 'Let's Go to the Movies' segment [1:06:03].

episode_summary: Barely Informed News sprints through a holiday gauntlet: Case debuts a shorter haircut and an AI Santa Hype Train parade, Jeff Ripple covers AI porn doppelgangers while threatening a sabbatical, dual Joe Rogans pitch beehive-mailbox economies and AK-47 Christmas tree hunts, The Unverted speed-runs a Saturnalia conspiracy implicating Russell Crowe, Trent reviews trailers from a three-year theater lease, Munch installs a one-day temp (Scrum) to challenge Crum in a near-tied poll, and Munch closes with a 'Munch Miss' rap claiming nuclear-curse immortality and true Santa status — all before a hard pivot to the Patreon creamies stream.
